title: 第13章 五大皇子齐聚宫内的规矩第14章 太医诊治也没人说要送礼啊
slug: 八年质子归京岂知天下已刻吾名
lines: 大虞皇宫，气势恢宏。
青玉石铺地，一条条金龙盘柱耸立，穹顶上方雕梁画栋，纹路栩栩如生，宛若天龙压顶。
最上方中央，则是一把由无数真龙交融而成的王座。
置身殿中，哪怕是大宗师境界的强者站在这里，也会忍不住紧张颤抖，想要跪伏下去。
不过。
此时的金殿内，却是琴瑟声起，数十娇俏的舞姬妩媚生花，莲步飘动，殿宇内袅袅生香，悠悠悦耳。
下方，一座座玉石桌上，早已摆放满山珍海味，其中更是有世人见都没见过的灵兽奇珍，被制作成了一道道膳食。
孟尘人未至，殿内已经落座了不少人，如武宁侯，宁国候，秦王，凌王等人，皆早早到来。
他们身后，还跟随着不少人，全都是各自府邸中的强者，有着赫赫威名，随便走出一人，都可独自开辟一个门派的高手。
不过，来到这金殿中，他们也只能老实站在后面，并没有落座的资格。
秦王之子秦骁，也跟着来了。
镇国王府，也有人到场，想要亲眼见一见现在的六皇子。
镇国王府的人前来，足以说明前日他们入宫所求，并未对虞皇的赐婚有任何影响。
此外，今日五大皇子都会到场。
甚至，常年游历天下的五皇子也回来了，要出席这接风宴。
皇子的位置，按照顺序排列，大皇子自然坐在首位。
而给孟尘安排的位置，自然是末位。
虽说，大虞除了孟尘外，还有其他皇子，不过那些皇子尚且年幼，还都未成长起来。
能在这金殿上落座的，每一个背后，都代表着大虞的恐怖权势。
在众人看来，若非孟尘为质八年回归，又得到了虞皇赐婚黎清月给他，否则根本没资格坐在这里。
又过了片刻。
皇宫中参加这接风宴的人陆续到来，有大虞的公主，以及王府中的各个郡主，其中还包括后宫多位妃子。
如孟尘的生母玉妃也出现了。
这接风宴，是专门为了迎接孟尘而准备，身为孟尘的生母，即便在宫中没什么权势，今日也没人能干预她到场。
紧接着，皇子们来了。
首先步入大殿的，是大皇子孟昊。
他身形伟岸，龙行虎步，身上流露出天生皇道气息，双眸神辉熠熠间，散发出无形霸气与洒脱。
随后，又有一人出现，正是二皇子孟承。
他淡笑内敛，十分谦和低调，不过发丝却根根晶莹，好似在发光，难掩至尊骨的惊艳风姿。
三皇子人还未出现。
大殿内的众人，心头便猛地一惊，好似感受到了一股无形星辰威压降临！
三皇子孟天来了！
他双眼朦胧，好似被仙雾遮拢，整个人直接渡空而来，脚尖离地三寸，不染丝毫凡俗尘埃。
众人心惊。
他们虽然都知道三皇子资质近仙，但三皇子备受宠爱，常年在秘地中潜修，即便见面也没机会见三皇子出过手，眼下看到这一幕，怎能不惊？
莫非，三皇子的实力，已经超过了其他皇子？
脚踏虚空而行，这至少是大宗师才能够做到的程度。
当然，还有另外一种可能，那就是三皇子天生异瞳，出生之日伴有星辰异象，若借助星辰异象之力做到，也有可能。
相比于近仙的三皇子，四皇子孟胤孟则平凡无比。
他一袭锦衣，缓步而来，手中只有一把白纸扇，眉宇之间透着阴柔与贵气，依旧是众人曾经看到过的模样。
相比于前面三位皇子，殿中的众人，则要更对四皇子忌惮一些。
毕竟，看不见的手段才最可怕，他手中掌控着暗夜军，检查着皇城内外的所有动向，没有人想得罪他。
“哈哈，想不到今日四位皇兄都到齐了！”
殿外，一道笑声传来，五皇子孟泽到来。
content_en:
Dayu Palace is magnificent.
The sapphire stone paved the ground, and golden dragon columns stood tall. The carved beams and painted pillars above the dome were lifelike, like a dragon pressing down on the top.
In the center of the top is a throne made of countless real dragons.
When standing in the palace, even a strong person in the realm of a grand master can't help but feel nervous and tremble, wanting to kneel down.
but.
At this time, in the Golden Palace, the sound of harp and zither was playing, and dozens of pretty dancers were dancing with charming flowers and fluttering lotus steps. The fragrance was lingering in the palace, which was long and sweet.
Below, the jade tables were already filled with delicacies from the mountains and seas, including rare treasures of spiritual beasts that no one in the world had ever seen, and they were made into meals.
Before Meng Chen arrived, many people were already seated in the palace, such as Marquis Wu Ning, Marquis Ning Guo, King Qin, King Ling and others, who all arrived early.
Behind them, there are many people following, all of whom are strong men in their respective mansions. They have great reputations. Anyone who steps out can be a master of a sect on his own.
However, when they came to this golden palace, they could only stand at the back and were not qualified to sit down.
Qin Xiao, the son of King Qin, also followed.
Some people were also present at the Zhen Wang Mansion, wanting to see the current sixth prince in person.
The arrival of the people from the King's Palace shows that what they asked for in the palace the day before yesterday did not have any impact on Emperor Yu's marriage grant.
In addition, the five princes will be present today.
Even the fifth prince, who has been traveling around the world all year round, is back and wants to attend the reception banquet.
The positions of the princes are arranged in order, and the eldest prince naturally sits at the top.
The position assigned to Meng Chen was naturally the last one.
Although Dayu has other princes besides Meng Chen, those princes are still young and have not grown up yet.
Everyone who can sit in this golden palace represents the terrifying power of Dayu.
In everyone's opinion, if Meng Chen hadn't returned as a hostage after eight years and received Li Qingyue's marriage from Emperor Yu, he wouldn't have the right to sit here.
Another moment passed.
People from the palace came to attend the reception banquet one after another, including the princess of Dayu and various princesses in the palace, including many concubines from the harem.
For example, Meng Chen's biological mother Yu Fei also appeared.
This reception banquet was specially prepared to welcome Meng Chen. As Meng Chen's biological mother, even though she had no power in the palace, no one could interfere with her presence today.
Immediately afterwards, the princes arrived.
The first person to enter the hall was the eldest prince Meng Hao.
He has a majestic figure, walking like a dragon and walking like a tiger. His body exudes the aura of a natural emperor, and his eyes are shining, exuding invisible domineering and free and easy.
Then, another person appeared, it was the second prince Meng Cheng.
He smiled lightly and was restrained, very humble and low-key, but his hair was all sparkling and translucent, as if it was shining, which could not hide the stunning grace of the Supreme Bones.
The third prince has not yet appeared.
Everyone in the hall was shocked, as if they felt the pressure of an invisible star coming!
The third prince Meng Tian is here!
His eyes were hazy, as if covered by fairy mist, and his whole body flew directly through the air, with his toes three inches above the ground, untainted by any mundane dust.
Everyone was shocked.
Although they all knew that the third prince's qualifications were close to those of an immortal, he was so favored that he cultivated in secret places all year round. Even if they met, they would never have the chance to see the third prince take action. How could they not be shocked when they saw this scene now?
Could it be that the strength of the third prince has surpassed that of the other princes?
Walking on the void is at least something only a great master can do.
Of course, there is another possibility, that is, the third prince was born with strange eyes, and was accompanied by star phenomena on the day of his birth. It is also possible if he uses the power of star phenomena to achieve this.
Compared to the third prince of Jinxian, the fourth prince Meng Yinmeng was extremely ordinary.
He was dressed in brocade clothes and came slowly, with only a white paper fan in his hand. There was femininity and nobility between his brows, and he still looked the same as everyone had seen him before.
Compared to the previous three princes, everyone in the palace was more wary of the fourth prince.
After all, invisible means are the most terrifying. He controls the Dark Night Army and checks all movements inside and outside the imperial city. No one wants to offend him.
"Haha, I didn't expect all four royal brothers to be here today!"
Outside the palace, a sound of laughter came, and the fifth prince Meng Ze arrived.
